agric.description: Amfanin gona, ƙasa, dabbobi da kasuwancin gona.

government.name: Ilimin Gwamnati
government.description: Yadda ake gudanar da ƙasashe, da dalilin da ya sa hakan yake da muhimmanci.

economics.name: Tattalin Arziki
economics.description: Kuɗi, kasuwanni da yadda ake yanke shawara.

entrepreneurship.name: Harkar Kasuwanci
entrepreneurship.description: Mayar da ra’ayoyi su zama kasuwancin da ke aiki.

computer-science.name: Kimiyyar Kwamfuta
computer-science.description: Yadda kwamfuta ke tunani, daga dabaru (logic) zuwa code.

ai-literacy.name: Ilimin AI
ai-literacy.description: Mene ne AI, yadda yake aiki da yadda za a yi amfani da shi yadda ya kamata.

l1.title: Yadda ƙwayoyin halitta (cells) ke samar da kuzari
l1.summary: Mitochondria na mayar da glucose da oxygen su zama ATP, kuɗin kuzari da kowace ƙwayar halitta ke kashewa.
keyPoints: Numfashi (respiration) na faruwa a cikin mitochondria
Numfashi ba tare da oxygen ba (anaerobic) yana samar da lactic acid a cikin tsoka

l2.title: Ilimin gado a sauƙaƙe: dominant da recessive
l2.summary: Dalilin da ya sa za ka iya samun idanun mahaifiyarka amma tsayin kakanka: alleles, genotypes da Punnett squares.
keyPoints: Kowace sifa (trait) tana da alleles biyu
Dominant alleles na ɓoye recessive alleles
Punnett squares na hasashen rabon ’ya’ya (offspring ratios)

l3.title: Sarƙar abinci da gudanar kuzari
l3.summary: Kuzari na tafiya daga masu samar da abinci (producers) zuwa masu cinsa (consumers), kuma kusan 10% kawai ke wucewa zuwa kowane mataki na gaba.
keyPoints: Producers na yin abinci ta hanyar photosynthesis
Kusan 10% na kuzari ke hawa zuwa kowane mataki
Decomposers (masu ruɓar da abubuwa) na sake maido da sinadaran abinci

l4.title: Ma’anar mole cikin minti 5
l4.summary: Mole ɗaya daidai yake da ƙwayoyi 6.02 × 10²³. Koyi yadda za ka sauya tsakanin nauyi (mass), moles da ƙwayoyi da ƙwarin gwiwa.
keyPoints: Yi amfani da rabo (ratios) daga daidaitattun lissafin sinadarai

l5.title: Ionic da covalent bonding
l5.summary: Ionic bonds na miƙa electrons; covalent bonds na raba su. Katunan bita 20 don ka riƙe shi sosai.
keyPoints: Ionic: ƙarfe (metal) + wanda ba ƙarfe ba (non-metal), miƙa electron
Ionic compounds na gudanar da wutar lantarki idan sun narke

l6.title: Organic chemistry: sanya wa alkanes suna
l6.summary: Gwada kanka kan tsarin sanya suna na IUPAC don alkanes, alkenes da alcohols.
keyPoints: Fara ƙirga daga ƙarshen da ya fi kusa da reshe

l7.title: Dokokin Newton guda uku, an bayyana su
l7.summary: Inertia, F = ma, da action–reaction, tare da misalai na yau da kullum daga motar danfo zuwa ƙwallon ƙafa.
keyPoints: Abu na zama a tsaye sai dai idan wani ƙarfi ya yi aiki a kansa
Kowane aiki (action) yana da martani (reaction) daidai da shi kuma akasinsa

l8.title: Dokar Ohm da sauƙaƙan circuits
l8.summary: V = IR. Yadda voltage, current da resistance ke da alaƙa a cikin series da parallel circuits.

l9.title: Raƙuma: frequency, wavelength, gudu
l9.summary: Tambayoyi goma irin na jarrabawa kan v = fλ.
keyPoints: Sauti yana buƙatar abin da zai bi (medium)

l10.title: Warware lissafin quadratic
l10.summary: Factorisation, completing the square da formula. Zaɓi hanya mafi sauri a kowane lokaci.
keyPoints: Discriminant na gaya maka adadin roots

l11.title: Trigonometry: SOH CAH TOA
l11.summary: Rabon sine, cosine da tangent tare da dabarun tunawa da ba za su manta ba.

l12.title: Ƙididdiga: mean, median da mode
l12.summary: Hanyoyi uku na bayyana “tsakiyar” bayanai (data), da lokacin amfani da kowace.

l13.title: Differentiation daga first principles
l13.summary: Ainihin ma’anar derivative, an gina shi mataki-mataki.
keyPoints: Derivative shi ne saurin canji (rate of change)

l14.title: Rubuta gabatarwar maƙala mai ƙarfi
l14.summary: Hook, bayanin baya, thesis: gabatarwa mai sassa uku da masu duba jarrabawa ke so.

l15.title: Rubuta taƙaitawa da ke samun maki
l15.summary: Yadda za ka nemo muhimman batutuwa ka sake rubuta su da kalmominka, cikin iyakar adadin kalmomi.
keyPoints: Kada ka taɓa kwafar jumla gaba ɗaya

l16.title: Atisayen Lexis & structure
l16.summary: Synonyms, antonyms da cike jumla irin na JAMB.
keyPoints: Cire zaɓuɓɓukan da ke a fili ba daidai ba

l17.title: Things Fall Apart: jigogi
l17.summary: Girman kai, al’ada da canji a cikin fitaccen littafin Achebe, a matsayin darasin sauti da za ka iya saurara ko’ina.
keyPoints: Tsoron Okonkwo na zama mai rauni

l18.title: Buƙata da wadata, a sauƙaƙe
l18.summary: Dalilin da ya sa farashi ke hauhawa da faɗuwa, ta amfani da kasuwar tumatir a matsayin misali.
keyPoints: Buƙata (demand) na raguwa idan farashi ya hau
Wadata (supply) na ƙaruwa idan farashi ya hau
Equilibrium shi ne inda suka haɗu

l19.title: Hauhawar farashi: dalilin da ya sa farashi ke ci gaba da hauhawa
l19.summary: Dalilai, illoli da yadda bankunan tsakiya (central banks) ke yaƙi da hauhawar farashi.
keyPoints: Hauhawar farashi na rage ƙarfin sayayya (purchasing power)
Kuɗin ruwa (interest rates) shi ne babban makami

l20.title: Double entry bookkeeping
l20.summary: Kowace ma’amala tana da ɓangarori biyu. Debits, credits da accounting equation.
keyPoints: Kowane debit yana da credit da ya yi daidai da shi
Yi amfani da T-accounts don yin atisaye

l21.title: Ɓangarorin gwamnati
l21.summary: Majalisar dokoki, ɓangaren zartarwa da ɓangaren shari’a: wa ke yin me.
keyPoints: Ɓangaren zartarwa (executive) na aiwatar da su

l22.title: ’Yancin kan Najeriya cikin muhimman lokuta 10
keyPoints: Samun ’yancin kai a ranar 1 ga Oktoba 1960

l23.title: Karatun contour maps
l23.summary: Contours, spot heights da gradients, an fayyace su.
keyPoints: Contours masu kusanci = gangare mai tsauri
Siffofin V na nuna sama da kogi (upstream)

l24.title: Shirin Python ɗinka na farko
l24.summary: Variables, print da input: rubuta shirin da zai gaishe ka da sunanka.
keyPoints: input() na karanta abin da mai amfani ya rubuta

l25.title: Algorithms a rayuwar yau da kullum
l25.summary: Girke-girke, kwatance da tsara jerin waƙoƙinka: algorithms suna ko’ina.
keyPoints: Algorithms masu kyau suna da inganci (efficient)

l26.title: Mene ne AI, a zahiri?
l26.summary: Yadda na’urori ke koyon tsari (patterns) daga bayanai (data), da abin da har yanzu ba za su iya yi ba.
keyPoints: AI na koyon patterns daga misalai
Yana hasashe ne, ba wai yana “sani” ba

l27.title: Rubuta prompt kamar ƙwararre
l27.summary: Ba da bayanin baya, sanya matsayi (role) ka kuma nemi tsari (format): samu amsoshi mafi kyau daga AI.

l28.title: Ƙayyade farashin kayanka na farko
l28.summary: Cost-plus, value-based da competitor pricing ga matasan ’yan kasuwa.
keyPoints: San jimillar kuɗin da ka kashe
Ƙayyade farashi bisa amfani (value), ba kawai kuɗin da ka kashe ba

l29.title: Gaisuwa da gabatar da kai a Faransanci
l29.summary: Bonjour, ça va? Faɗi jumlolinka na farko na Faransanci da ƙwarin gwiwa.

l30.title: Electrolysis mataki-mataki
l30.summary: Abin da ke faruwa a anode da cathode, da yadda za a yi hasashen abubuwan da za a samu (products).
keyPoints: Oxidation a anode, reduction a cathode

l31.title: Zuciyar ɗan Adam da zagayawar jini
l31.summary: Tambayoyi goma sha biyu kan zuciya, jijiyoyin jini da double circulation.
keyPoints: Arteries na ɗauke jini daga zuciya
Double circulation a cikin dabbobi masu shayarwa (mammals)

l32.title: Ilimin siffofi: kusurwoyi a cikin da’ira
l32.summary: Circle theorems tare da zane-zanen da za ka iya bi a zahiri.
keyPoints: Kusurwa a tsakiya = 2 × kusurwa a kewaye (circumference)
Kusurwoyi a cikin segment ɗaya daidai suke
Kusurwoyi masu fuskantar juna na cyclic quad suna haɗuwa su zama 180°
